NeuralNg ProgressBar rules

- Import NeuralProgressBar only from `@neural-ng/core/progress-bar`.
- Add NeuralProgressBar directly to standalone component imports.
- Determinate mode is the default and uses numeric value, min, and max inputs.
- Value and bufferValue are clamped to the effective range.
- bufferValue never renders behind value.
- Use mode="indeterminate" when the completion value is unknown.
- Indeterminate mode intentionally omits aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow.
- Always give an unlabeled ProgressBar ariaLabel or ariaLabelledBy.
- Use label for visual text and ariaValueText for a localized or descriptive accessible value.
- showValue=false hides only the visual label; it does not remove progress semantics.
- Sizes: `small`, `medium`, `large`.
- Severities: primary, secondary, neutral, info, success, warning, error.
- striped adds stripes; animated moves them when motion preferences allow.
- Reduced-motion preferences disable all ProgressBar animation and transitions.
- `unstyled` removes visual classes while structural hooks remain.
- Slots: root, track, buffer, value, label.
- Global unstyled mode is `provideNeuralNg({ unstyled: true })`.
- ProgressBar is for linear progress. Do not treat it as ProgressSpinner.
